title: Ordinary scalar bounded models descend to bounded constructibility
statement: Let A be a commutative topological ring whose canonical scalar realizations C_T [def-sfb-finite-constant-model-data] are additive and exact for all schemes T. Let S be quasi-compact and locally Noetherian, and Q an object of D(A_S). Suppose a pro-etale cover U_i -> S carries scalar cochain models F_i with Q|U_i isomorphic to C_(U_i)(F_i), where every F_i is bounded (the bounds may depend on i), and every scalar H^q(F_i) is finitely presented over A. Then Q is bounded constructible in the finite constant local-model sense [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. This applies to one arbitrary object, with no dual or projectivity hypothesis.

proof.text: A quasi-compact locally Noetherian scheme is quasi-separated. Choose a finite affine open cover and refine the given pro-etale cover to a finite affine family. Empty schemes admit the empty finite cover.

Restrict the given scalar models to that refinement. Coefficient localization and exact restriction preserve the canonical constant scalar maps and identify iterated realization with realization on the refining schemes.

Evaluation of a continuous function at the point identifies the scalar ring with A, with its universe lift. The equivalence of ordinary scalar modules and internal abelian-group scalar modules identifies the model functor with finiteConstantScalarExtension. It transports finite matrix presentations, cohomology and zero terms.

The finite list of original scalar intervals has a common minimum and maximum, enlarged to contain zero. Apply localModel_cohomology_descent to these transported exact models and finitely presented homology modules. It gives boundedness and constructibility of Q on the single stratum S. For the empty cover all sheaves are zero and [0,0] works.

lean.statement: theorem ordinaryScalarModel_bounded_descent (S : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (Q : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology S) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj A) S))) (𝒰 : Scheme.Cover.{u} Scheme.proetalePrecoverage S) (F : 𝒰.I₀ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) (hexact : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, PreservesFiniteLimits (FiniteConstantModel.modelFunctor A T) ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits (FiniteConstantModel.modelFunctor A T)) (hbounded : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q → IsZero ((F i).X q)) (hmodel : ∀ i : 𝒰.I₀, Nonempty (((CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj A) (𝒰.f i)).mapDerivedCategory).obj Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((FiniteConstantModel.modelFunctor A (𝒰.X i)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (F i)))) (hfp : ∀ (i : 𝒰.I₀) (q : ℤ), Module.FinitePresentation A ((F i).homology q)) : constantModelBoundedConstructible (Profinite.continuousCoefficientRingObj A) S Q
